bibl.title: A Syntactic Approach to the Orphic Gold Leaves.
bibl.seg: Attila Egyed, A Syntactic Approach to the Orphic Gold Leaves.
bibl.note: Introduction. - The Gold Leaves and Orphism. - Textual Components and their Religious Context. - Texts in Ring Composition. - Opening Components (Present and Implicit Past). - Retrospections (Past). - Closing Components (Present, Future). - Texts with a Chiastic Pattern (Present, Past, Performative Future). - Exploring the Timeline. - The Sphragis. - The Syntax of Makarismoi. - Semantic Variations on a Syntactic Element. - The Use of the Imperfect. - The Use of Resultatives. - Religious Dynamics. - Conclusion.
